about: Particle, pore and surface characterisation: load / unload, prepare, method (only the keys that change), calibrate, set-temp, atmosphere, start (job) / stop / result in plain units, analyze, status.  Ranges, enums and units come from each member's contract; "max" / "min" positions are the contract argument limits.

excluded.ta_tga5500: considered as a possible secondary (gravimetric, sorption-like); it has no humidity / vapour step method, no sample access the class verbs would close and no sorption result - thermal_analysis owns it and no particle_surface verb would add anything
excluded.antonpaar_dma5002: considered as a possible secondary (density); it measures liquid density in an oscillating U-tube (property_meter owns it); the class density instrument is the gas pycnometer (Ultrapyc 5000)

start.message: there is no sample in {inst}.
start.fix: the lab operator must put the sample in (`chemlab run {inst} unload` opens the access for it), then `chemlab run {inst} load`.

start.label: laser warmed up
start.message: the laser of {inst} is still warming up ({value} s of 6 min after switching on).
start.fix: wait: `chemlab wait 360` (or less, see `chemlab run {inst} status`), then start again.

load.label: power on

unsupported.prepare: no separate preparation: the cell temperature is equilibrated inside each measurement (method equilibration=)
unsupported.set-temp: the cell temperature is part of the method (temp=), not a separate set point
unsupported.analyze: the result is already evaluated (Z-average, PDI, size distribution, zeta potential)

alternatives.set-temp: set it in the method: `chemlab run INST method temp=25C`

GAS_EXHAUSTED.message: the dry-gas purge supply of {inst} is empty.

PURGE_REQUIRED.message: the method temperature of {inst} is below the dew point, so the cell needs the dry-gas purge.
PURGE_REQUIRED.fix: `chemlab run {inst} atmosphere gas=on` (the operator must have connected the purge gas).

load: order: cell cap, cuvette down, lid; steps already done are skipped
atmosphere: gas=on|off switches the dry-gas purge that keeps the cell dry below the dew point
method: cell=quartz|omega declares the cuvette (cell.configure); zeta needs the omega cell and angle=15deg
start: the laser needs 6 min after switching on (laser.warmup_s)

BACKFILL_INTERLOCK.message: {inst} backfills a station only with the dewar down, the guard closed and every tube on its port.

PRESSURE_ACCESS_INTERLOCK.message: {inst} moves a sample tube only with the safety guard open and the dewar down.

dewar.set:COOLANT_OR_POWER.message: the dewar of {inst} is empty (or the instrument is off).
dewar.set:COOLANT_OR_POWER.fix: ask the lab operator to fill liquid nitrogen; `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start: --cell 1,2,3 measures several stations at once (one job)
load: load raises every tube holder, closes the guard and raises the dewar (the dewar rises only with all tubes on their ports)
unload: unload --cell N lowers the dewar, backfills the station with nitrogen to ambient pressure (waits for it), opens the guard and lowers tube N for the operator
prepare: degasses the samples in the degas ports (not the analysis stations): --temp, --hold, --ramp; a job that follows degas.phase
